scripts.build: bun run --filter @notara/shared build && bun run --filter '!@notara/electron' build
scripts.build:electron: bun run --filter @notara/shared build && bun run --filter @notara/server build && bun run --filter @notara/app build && bun run --filter @notara/electron build
scripts.typecheck: for pkg in packages/*/; do if [ -f "$pkg/tsconfig.json" ]; then (cd "$pkg" && bunx tsc --noEmit) || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.quickcheck: bun run --filter @notara/shared build && bun typecheck && bun run typecheck:tests && bun run test
scripts.lint:effect: for pkg in packages/*/; do if [ -f "$pkg/tsconfig.json" ]; then bunx effect-tsgo diagnostics --project "$pkg/tsconfig.json" --severity error,warning --strict --format text || exit 1; fi; done
scripts.pre-merge: bun run quickcheck && bunx @biomejs/biome ci packages/ e2e/ && bun run lint:effect && bash scripts/check-effect-errors.sh && bash scripts/check-bundle-size.sh
scripts.coverage: bash scripts/check-coverage.sh '@notara/server' packages/server 'bun test' && bash scripts/check-coverage.sh '@notara/app' packages/app 'bun test' && bash scripts/check-coverage.sh '@notara/electron' packages/electron 'bun test' && bash scripts/check-coverage.sh '@notara/shared' packages/shared 'bunx vitest run'

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: bunx @biomejs/biome check --write --unsafe packages/ e2e/ && git add -u
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: bunx @biomejs/biome ci packages/ e2e/ && bash scripts/check-effect-errors.sh && bun run quickcheck
